# High-Performance NGINX Configuration & SSL Hardening

Hardened NGINX reverse proxy: TLS 1.3 only, HSTS headers, Brotli compression, rate limiting zones, and keepalive upstream pools.

## Invariants
- TLS_1_3_AND_1_2_ONLY_NO_INSECURE_CIPHERS
- ENABLE_STRICT_TRANSPORT_SECURITY_HSTS
- UPSTREAM_KEEPALIVE_CONNECTION_POOLS
